resources.string: For DV8 (Profile 8) content stripped to an HDR10 base layer, add the source\'s mastering metadata (MaxCLL/MaxFALL and peak luminance) so non-DV HDR10 TVs tone-map correctly. Only active when DV Handling is Strip DV or HDR10 Base Layer; no effect on Profile 7 or on Dolby Vision playback.
